title: The Create Experience
description: A bunch of different performance mods, as well as aesthetic resource packs, and of course, Create + loads of super fun Create addons.
body:
Welcome to The Create Experience! This modpack focuses on not only making gameplay more fun and creative by adding the Create mod and a lot of it's addons, but also the very much needed performance!

## Create mod:
As you've probably already understood, the modpack aims to brings out the most fun from the Create mod by simibubi, by adding a load of different addons that are both fun in singleplayer _and_ multiplayer. You've got the essential; Steam 'n' rails by IThunderxr, the cool and complexingly electrifying; New Age by Antartic Gardens and Crafts & Additions by mrh0, and the best decorative; Deco by talrey and Bells and Whistles by a0a7. All of these make up a highly customisable and advanced-by-choice Create experience. All that is only some of the really niche addons that have been added to the modpack.

## Performance:
But with all of these "heavy duty" mods, what about the performance? Well no worries! Since with this there are many optimisations and performance mods that have been installed. You've got entity and block culling, Sodium by CaffieneMC(and Sodium Extra by FlashyReese), RAM optimisations, Lithium by CaffieneMC, and CPU usage improvements. 

## Terrain
There is a lot to talk about in for this catagory, but really it's something you should see for yourself. This modpack includes 2 mods that completely alter world generation. The first, is Tectonic. The mountains are not only higher, but they can generate in many different mountain formations. I've made a specific alteration to the config allowing mountains to generate up to 512 blocks and caves can generate down to -128! There's more realistic plains and plateaus, ultrasmooth terrain and larger biomes. What Tectonic doesn't do is alter or add any biomes in specific. Which is exactly where Terralith comes in. Terralith essentially completely changes the way biomes look, feel, and all whilst adding new ones! There's lots of new villages and new types of caves.

## Visuals and ambience
What would make this better? Some great visuals and ambience would! We'll start with resource packs. Think plains and forests look dull and boring? Os' Colorful leaves and grasses has got you (it does exactly what the name suggests). Cobblestone looks sad and repetative? Os' colorful cobblestone! You think foliage looks unnatural? Getcha some rainbow's foliage! You think sounds echo unrealistically? Here's Sound Physics remastered! The rain's bad? Cool rain, Angel's weather, and Particle rain has come to save you! If you want to up the quality even more then I've installed 2 shaderpacks for you that I think go really well with all these mods. The first is Photon. Photon does a great job of handling lighting (and sunrays) and balancing performance whilst still looking good. The shaderpack is highly customisable and even has presets for quality. Then there's Bliss. I think Bliss has some extremely good fog and can sometimes make you forget that you're in a game! Just like Photon, Bliss has many customisable options and is really good at depicting a fantasy style. Which ever one you choose it's going to be a really beautiful experience. (you might have to enable the shaders ingame)

## Extra
There are a few QoL mods installed such as Tree Harvester and VeinDigging. There's also Xaero's mini-map and world-map, acting as decisive tools for exploring this new and imrpoved large terrain.

# Enjoy!
(and thank you a lot for downloading)
